{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish mid-rite, her voice stumbling over the words she cannot name, and the presiding Dohkar is about to call her out in front of everyone",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren kneels in the spiralgrass, her hands trembling as she begins the invocation—but her voice cracks, the practiced words twisting into something else, and the Dohkar’s fingers tighten around his ceremonial sash.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "The Dohkar’s gaze snaps to Seren’s face, his expression unreadable, but his posture shifts—just slightly—toward the assembled crowd, not her.",
      "Julian’s stillness at the edge of the clearing breaks as he leans forward, his attention locked on Seren’s mouth, the only one who notices the way her fingers dig into the grass."
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Do I let the rite twist further, or tear the band from my mouth and risk the scandal of breaking protocol to stop her?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the frayed edge of the Dohkar’s ceremonial sash, pulled taut by his grip",
      "the deep crimson spiralgrass, crushed where Seren’s knees press into it"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "the presiding Dohkar — the senior officiant who has led this rite a hundred times, his silver-streaked hair pulled into a tight knot, his fingers always adjusting the knot when he is impatient",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "I adjust the muffling band across my mouth, my fingers brushing the embroidered threadwork—too tight, the way I always tie it when I’m afraid of what I’ll say.",
    "scene_want": "I want Seren to finish the wish without the Dohkar seeing the cost she’s hiding in it.",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren from twisting the wish before the Dohkar calls her out in front of everyone.",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is breaking the rite’s rules, the Dohkar is about to intervene, and Lirael is the only one who can halt it—but she can’t speak.",
      "believes": "The cost of Seren’s sacrifice is something she’s never named aloud, and the Dohkar will punish her for it.",
      "wondering": "Why is Julian watching Seren like he already knows what she’s hiding?",
      "must_not_confuse": "The Dohkar’s impatience is not kindness; Seren’s stumble is deliberate, not a mistake; Julian is not here to help."
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the embroidered threadwork of the band)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way his gaze lingers on Seren’s mouth, as if he’s listening for something she won’t say)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s fingers dig into the spiralgrass as she forces the words out, her voice softening the edges of the wound she won’t name.",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O3"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of naming the wound plainly reveals her belief that softening it is kinder than making it endure direct recognition.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "She’s hiding the cost from herself as much as from the Dohkar."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-9",
        "expression_mode": "CONTROL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s fingers tighten around his sash, his knuckles whitening as he waits for Seren to finish—judging the cost too small for what’s being asked.",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "His controlled grip on the sash shows he assumes his judgment carries authority others haven’t earned.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "He’s already decided the cost doesn’t matter."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the Dohkar’s ceremonial sash",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "the frayed edge where his fingers have pulled it too tight, the embroidered threadwork snagged and splitting"
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "She’s already calculating how to stop Seren without breaking protocol—her body moves before her mind does.",
      "environment_target": "the Dohkar’s ceremonial sash",
      "environment_axis": "damage",
      "beat": "My fingers brush the frayed edge of the Dohkar’s sash as I adjust my own band, the threadwork catching on my nail—the same way it always does when I’m about to make a choice I shouldn’t."
    }
  }
}
